opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years for groups of 8-15 participants.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 with diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation; EDI principles required.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by funding new two-year synthesis groups that bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups of 8-15 individuals to focus on data analysis and synthesis, fostering collaboration and mentoring.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: £500 per year for a decade of data collection; first five years' funding (£3,500) claimable in year 1, additional £3,500 in year 6 (total £7,000).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners and university academics; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding over 10 years for long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world, enabling existing short-term projects with 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term, covering ecological restoration, habitat creation, alien species control and climate change.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level; awarded to individuals, not organisations; projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Improving the education of future generations of ecologists by funding research informing teaching and learning practices, providing up to £5k towards evidence-based learning in ecology education.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants

amount.raw: Grant awards of up to £20,000 can be claimed.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers or employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible; awarded to individuals.
opportunities.summary: Promoting interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements in different disciplines and sectors, immersing an ecologist in another professional world (discipline, NGO, public sector, business) for up to 12 months.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world; not a scholarship; BES funding cannot be used towards completion of an undergraduate or master's degree or funded fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Providing up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard, supporting work with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; projects max 12 months; no restrictions on where applicants come from.
opportunities.summary: Providing funding of up to £2,000 for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science through outreach, public engagement and science communication.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: A maximum of £250 is available to cover registration fees for virtual conferences/courses; a maximum of £500 is available for events in person.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member; must be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher (not postdocs, undergraduates or masters students); must work/study at a university or research institution; work in scientific areas within the BES remit.
opportunities.summary: Helping PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and the travel costs associated with presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in the Global South; must be travelling from and returning to the Global South country; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; at least three years since last BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting 2026 in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation costs up to £1,000.
